parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability to query. Default value: cve. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
app: application vulnerability (network scan)
sca: application vulnerability (software constituency parsing)
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。默认cve。取值：

cve：Linux漏洞
sys：Windows漏洞
cms：WebCMS漏洞
app：应用漏洞（网络扫描）
sca：应用漏洞（软件成分分析）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers to query. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的UUID。多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The alias of the vulnerability to query
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the vulnerability fix to query. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

asap: high
later: medium
nntf: low
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞修复的优先级。多个优先级使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is handled. Valid values:

y: handled
n: not handled
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞是否处理。取值：

y：已处理
n：未处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The page number of the first page to display in the query results. Default value: 1, which indicates that the results start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of vulnerability entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 vulnerability entries are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条漏洞信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The CVE ID.
Call the [DescribeVulListPage](~~DescribeVulListPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
CVE 编号。
调用[DescribeVulListPage](~~DescribeVulListPage~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: cve_id

nodeName: node name

image: image name

imageRepoTag: image tag
imageDigest: image digest

容器检索项。取值：

instanceId：实例ID
appName：应用名

nodeName：节点名
namespace：命名空间
clusterName：集群名称
image：镜像名称

parameters.help_en:
The container query type. Valid values:

containerId: container ID
uuid: asset ID
parameters.help_zh:
容器查询类型。取值：

containerId：容器ID
uuid：资产ID

The label used for filtering. Valid values:

Restart required
Remote utilization
EXP exists
Available
Privilege escalation
Code execution

需要重启
远程利用

可被利用
本地提权
代码执行

<props="intl">

Restart required
Remote utilization
EXP exists
Available

Code Execution

parameters.name: search_tags

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability type. This query condition is valid only for application vulnerabilities. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
sca: software constituency parsing vulnerability
app: application vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。该查询条件仅对查询应用漏洞有效。多个使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
sca：软件成分分析漏洞
app：应用漏洞
parameters.name: attach_types

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type where the vulnerability is detected. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:
ECS: host asset
CONTAINER: container asset
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞所在资产类型。多个类型使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
ECS：主机资产
CONTAINER：容器资产
parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is added as one of the member accounts in a resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) supports real-time protection against the vulnerability. Valid values:

0: Not supported.
1: Supported
parameters.help_zh:
应用防护（RASP）是否支持实时防护该漏洞。取值：

0：不支持
1：支持
parameters.name: rasp_defend

schema.description_en: The response for querying vulnerability information by group
schema.description_zh: 分组查询漏洞信息返回信息

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
